commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Jackson will be replaced by Malo Gusto (Chelsea).
90+4' Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cole Palmer.

90+4' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
90+2' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
90+1' Armando Broja (Chelsea) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Chelsea get a corner.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
89' The attendance for today's match is 39599.

88' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the bottom right corner, but Wesley Foderingham denies him with a great save.
88' Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
88' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
87' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) brings an opponent down and Andy Madley interrupts the game. That's a free kick to Chelsea.

84' Armando Broja (Chelsea) latches onto a short pass from Cole Palmer inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
83' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
80' Substitution. Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) replaces Gustavo Hamer.
80' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
79' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
75' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Armando Broja (Chelsea) replacing Raheem Sterling.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.

71' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) drills the free kick effort towards the bottom right corner, but Djordje Petrovic is well prepared and makes a good block to stop the ball from crossing the goal line. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sheffield Utd.
69' Here is a change. Mykhailo Mudryk is going off and Mauricio Pochettino gives the last tactical orders to Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver McBurnie departs the field of play to be replaced by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd).
63' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) goes wild in celebration.
63' Wait! Referee Andy Madley has indicated he is going to review the Chelsea goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
61' It's in the back of the net! Cole Palmer sprays a pass out to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andre Brooks trots off the pitch and is replaced by William Osula (Sheffield Utd).
57' The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
57' Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes wild in celebration.
56' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Chelsea players aren’t happy.
54' 1 - 0 Goal! Raheem Sterling plays a pass to the feet of Cole Palmer (Chelsea) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:0.
52' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
52' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 80:20.

47' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' Referee Andy Madley blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A clumsy foul by Levi Colwill (Chelsea) and Andy Madley blows his whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
42' Chelsea are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
39' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) picks up a long through ball, but Wesley Foderingham deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
36' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
35' Sheffield Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Sheffield Utd will have a corner.
33' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
29' A pass by Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
27' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
27' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
26' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
25' The linesman points to the corner flag, Sheffield Utd are going to take it.
25' One of the players from Sheffield Utd times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
25' A dangerous looking corner kick from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is cleared to safety by the defence.

24' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
22' A snap shot by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) from distance flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
22' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
18' The corner from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence.
18' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Chelsea have a corner.
17' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd).
15' A snap shot by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Wesley Foderingham produces a good save to thwart him.
15' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
11' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
10' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
7' The ball is cleared after Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andy Madley no option but to blow his whistle.
5' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Great teamplay by Chelsea as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
